idea-plugin.name: Ariada Accessibility
idea-plugin.description:
Ariada finds accessibility defects from inside the IDE, in two ways, and is clear about what each one can see.

  • Scan the open file — reads the markup as it currently stands in the editor, unsaved and unbuilt. Two checks: images without alternative text, and buttons with no accessible name.
  • Scan the site — runs the Ariada command-line scanner against a running local or staging address and lists everything it reports. This is the one that reaches the rules a page only settles once it has rendered.

Both run locally. Nothing is sent anywhere, and no model is called.
